facts.label: Passado simples e how many
facts.sub: Use o passado para falar de ontem: I baked cookies. Pergunte How many eggs did you use? e responda com um número: I used three eggs.

facts.label: Passado
facts.sub: Para falar de ontem, use o passado simples: I baked cookies yesterday. Os verbos regulares ganham -ed. Alguns verbos são irregulares, como make (made) e eat (ate). Aprenda a lista aos poucos.

facts.label: Quantos
facts.sub: Para perguntar uma quantidade, use How many + substantivo no plural: How many eggs did you use? A resposta é um número: I used three eggs. Use many com coisas que você conta.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Did you add + base verb is a past question.
We say “How many eggs did you used?”
Eggs are countable, so we use how many.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Did you add + base verb is a past question. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “How many eggs did you used?” → Falso (We say did you use.)
Eggs are countable, so we use how many. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A small kitchen · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Sunday morning in a small kitchen in London. The oven is still warm. Tom cleans a bowl of dough. His friend Luca comes in with a bag. He smells something sweet. He looks at the table.
“Hi, Tom! It smells great in here. What did you bake?” says Luca. “I baked cookies yesterday. I made forty.” says Tom. “Forty! How many eggs did you use?” says Luca.
